title: Junior Fullstack Developer(25748)
description:
Job Description
We are looking for a talented Junior Developer with a strong passion for software development to join our Salesforce team.
The role involves in-depth learning and hands-on Full-Stack development within the Salesforce environment, under the guidance and mentorship of senior developers — from writing code and assisting in building complex integrations to supporting DevOps processes and deployments.
Perform Full-Stack development in the Salesforce environment with close mentorship, focusing on learning and building expertise in Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC).
Participate in Technical Design discussions and gain in-depth exposure to software solution architecture and design for complex systems.
Assist in requirements analysis, design, and development of interfaces with third-party and enterprise systems.
Support the integration of external platforms with Salesforce and assist with managing security certificates and permissions.
Assist with deployments through CI/CD pipelines and learn deployment and release management processes.
Support preparation for and implementation of changes related to major Salesforce version upgrades.
Assist with managing and executing Sandbox Environment Refreshes.
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science / Software Engineering, including practical programming courses and a final project – required. No prior Salesforce experience is required.
Strong theoretical and practical foundation in software development principles, along with a strong motivation to learn Salesforce-specific technologies (Apex & LWC) from the ground up.
Willingness and strong desire to learn deployment processes, pipeline management, and software release cycles.
Basic understanding or academic/theoretical exposure to building integrations and interfaces with external systems.
Strong passion and drive to learn, grow, and develop technically within the Salesforce ecosystem.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to tackle complex challenges.
Excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills, a proactive mindset, and willingness to learn from and receive mentorship and guidance from senior developers.
